observations.disposition_note: Posture read with fnd_002: liability was imposed by the court (Dkt. 399), but this passage states ChromaDex's position (intends to appeal) and its accounting assessment; the finding states only that position, not that an amount has been imposed.
Conditional on appeal outcome, consistent with finding.
The date and docket identify the single order; the one claim is that the fee motion was granted against ChromaDex.
Single claim: the amount was left open for later resolution; 'did not fix' and 'directed a schedule to resolve' are the same fact.
One status claim: the amount question was pending decision as of the filing date.
The clauses are a single disclosure of ChromaDex's position and its conditional consequence; splitting would lose the condition.
Single amount statement with its stated qualifier; the qualifier is needed to avoid overstating precision.
If the appeal fails this is a cash obligation to Elysium; the finding records the amount estimate, not an accrual.
One payment obligation; the scope of matters it resolves and the date identify that single obligation.

Grouped deliberately so that every term in the judgment's decretal paragraph is covered; each term shares the same finality question (no further fee shifting, no appeal, enforcement window). Split would add no checking value.
